info.name: legit-hair
info.description:
Maintained Legit Hair backend samples for milestones B01-B12.

Folders are organized by API domain. Request names retain their milestone labels for traceability.
The full-regression folder duplicates every maintained domain request in B01-B12 dependency order so logins and generated test values are available before use.
The manual-regression folder contains controlled checks that require MariaDB to be stopped or a token captured from the fake email job; it is intentionally excluded from the ordinary full-regression run.
The frontend-handover folder contains the provider-safe role-login smoke that frontend can rerun without persisting tokens.
Select the Local environment and run `npm run seed:test` before workflows that require synthetic fixture IDs.
Provider and money-movement requests require separate test-mode authorization; this collection does not authorize live money movement.

exec: pm.test('healthy envelope', () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.data.status).to.eql('ok'); pm.expect(b.meta.requestId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('requestId')); });

request.description: Queues a one-hour password-reset token without revealing whether the account exists. For Gmail testing, set passwordResetEmail to a registered inbox and run the email worker. For the seeded .test fixture, capture the token only from the isolated test database.

exec: pm.test('enumeration-safe response', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.data.message).to.include('If the account exists'); });

request.description: Consumes the one-hour, single-use passwordResetToken and revokes existing access and refresh sessions. Never save a real token in the exported environment.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get('passwordResetToken')) { throw new Error('Set passwordResetToken from the reset email or isolated test database before sending this request.'); }

request.description: Confirms the new password works and replaces the local runtime tokens. Rerun npm run seed:test afterward when using the seeded fixture to restore FixturePass123!.

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('reset account returned', () => { pm.expect(b.data.user.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get('passwordResetEmail').toLowerCase()); pm.expect(b.data.user.emailVerified).to.eql(true); });
pm.environment.set('accessToken', b.data.tokens.accessToken); pm.environment.set('refreshToken', b.data.tokens.refreshToken); pm.environment.set('customerId', b.data.user.id);

const b=pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('accessToken', b.data.tokens.accessToken); pm.environment.set('refreshToken', b.data.tokens.refreshToken); pm.environment.set('customerId', b.data.user.id);
pm.test('opt out suppresses marketing', () => { const p=pm.response.json().data.preference; pm.expect(p.optedIn).to.eql(false); pm.expect(p.suppressed).to.eql(true); });
